g.text: The normalized operator is D³ + D² + D/12 + (54t − 5)/108; one wave per equation.
A parabola of lattices. Its two real degeneration parameters are t = 0 and t = 1/27.
Lattice of the full twisted period group Γ · Real invariants do not alone imply a bounded real profile.
